propositions: When structured-parse retry exhaustion occurs in _pai_structured's prompted branch and llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir is configured, the raw reply text, model id, contract name, and attempt count are written to a timestamped artifact file before the error is raised.
The parse_failure_artifact_dir config key defaults to None (disabled); when unset, the failure behavior is unchanged from today and no artifact is written.
Artifact write is best-effort and wrapped so I/O errors never mask the original parse validation error.
A successful parse takes the return path and never triggers artifact write, even when the key is configured.
Artifact directory is auto-created if absent, and rotation keeps at most 20 newest artifacts by mtime to prevent unbounded growth.
